findings.text: The node goal is to remove the dominant read its own census names, but the census ranks _backends._cached_stream_entry at 42.7 percent of the dominant input; this change repairs _newest_result_event, the 19.5 percent reader beneath it (line 806), and the live done_when bound is measured unmet in both arms (1,376 and 1,724 MB/min against 20, above 75 percent of one core against 5), so the measure the node was dispatched against is not moved.

Duplicates an owner the repository already has: reckon/_backends.py:4255 stream_head_fingerprint and reckon/_backends.py:4266 _stream_head_intact already digest a stream's bounded opening and compare it under a cursor, and this file already imports that module for _stream_lines_from at line 843. The copies differ only in the sample size (256 here against _STREAM_HEAD_SAMPLE = 8 * 1024), so the rewrite check this node relies on is the weaker of the two and the two bounds can drift apart silently.

The verdict-equality assertion compares classify_tick against recovery_watch._watch_snapshot, the very function the tick calls, and both sides read the same module-global _NEWEST_RESULTS cursor, so a cursor that returned a stale result would be returned to both sides and the assertion would hold: it is not independent of the value under test and does not guard the fold it reads as guarding.

The byte assertion is the durable guard for this change (the base arm reads 11,009,290 against the 1,000,000 bound), but line 969 total >= 10_000_000, line 1006 len(records) >= STREAM_RUNS and line 1011 over > 0 are fixture preconditions rather than guards: they fail only if the fixture shrinks or the code stops reading, never on a regression of the cursor, so counting four assertions as four guards overstates the coverage.

_touch_newest_result and _evict_newest_results exist to keep a plain-dict monkeypatch of _NEWEST_RESULTS (tests/test_a_lane_signal_reads_a_stream_once.py:20) working, so product code carries getattr probing and an isinstance branch for a test's chosen container; the store's own eviction already has owners at reckon/_backends.py:3651 and reckon/_backends.py:3735 that evict an OrderedDict without the duck-typing.

The second repaired window's 1,724 MB/min and 78.0 percent figures are cited with no surviving receipt: the census scratch directory the manifest's artifacts line names (/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/.../census/logs/) no longer exists, and the 235 s window log itself records that its raw samples were overwritten by that second window, so one of the three numbers the RCA's table states cannot be read back from any log.

The done_when's clause that ruff check and ruff format --check on the staged paths add no finding is unrecorded: the manifest's tests, test_logs, after_suite and artifacts carry three pytest arms and no lint arm, so one element of the gate the node was measured against has no receipt either way.
